wip.summary: A sprawling multi biome dungeon with many entrances and exists, traps, puzzles and more, one of our largest maps yet

maps.name: Webwood
maps.description: A dense, ancient forest choked with thick, unyielding spider silk. Navigating these darkened woods requires cutting through sticky traps and obscured paths, all while avoiding the gaze of the massive arachnids that hunt from the canopy above.

maps.name: War Camp
maps.description: The Warcamp is more than just a collection of tents, it’s the staging ground for a force that doesn’t believe in mercy. I wanted this map to feel heavy and dangerous, with the massive command tent acting as the "HQ" where the Ravagers plot their next strike.

maps.name: The Sacre Mal
maps.description: Sacre Mal, a cathedral of fractured marble and rhythmic decay, where the pious and the putrid gather to witness the ultimate sacrifice. Whether you come to kneel in the pews or bleed upon the stones, the Grand Prelate is always looking for fresh converts. Survive the liturgy, and you might just leave with your spirit intact... testing character length and if the window conforms correctly to the way it should conform because it is being a lil bitch and wants to extend horizontally and not vertically ahahahahababababsjfbaskjhfbkjasbfkjasbkjfbakjsbfkjsabj

maps.name: Crimson Lounge
maps.description: Welcome to the Crimson Lounge, the city’s most exclusive subterranean crypt. Dim lights, vintages, and zero sunlight, it’s the bougiest spot for your players to meet a contact (or become the main course).

maps.name: The Red Hand
maps.description: So, you heard about the Red Hand? Look, it ain't pretty. Don't expect comfort, expect cheap ale and shifty eyes... But if you're desperate, or just plain mad, that noticeboard outside is usually crawling with the kind of work the good folk pretend doesn't exist

maps.name: Solar Keep
maps.description: Perched high where the sky meets the stone, Solar Keep is a majestic fortification designed to harness and defend the power of the sun. Its gleaming marble halls and open-air battlements provide a brilliant setting for celestial rituals, strategic sieges, or an encounter with a radiant foe.

maps.name: Scarecrows Watch
maps.description: The Village came together to build a guardian, One large enough to scare all who would ruin their crops. Years past and some say the guardian took on a mind of it's own, scaring away even those who built it. Now only the faithful remain, treating it like some dark god.

maps.name: Necropolis
maps.description: Necropolis is a small, atmospheric graveyard designed to bring a sense of history and unease to your game. I wanted this map to feel old and overgrown, where the narrow paths between headstones and the shadows of the monuments make every step feel a bit heavier.

maps.name: Hunters Guild Hall
maps.description: A bastion for those who make their living in the shadows of the world’s most dangerous predators. This isn't a place of luxury, but of necessity a reinforced lodge where the air smells of pine resin, whetstones, and dried trophies.

maps.name: Deathdome
maps.description: Deathdome, a place of raw entertainment for the living and undead alike.Take a gamble or fight your way to the top, impress the patron of the House and you just might walk away with your life, and a Bone coin or two.

maps.name: Carrion Carnival
maps.description: A macabre festival filled with twisted games and dark performances. Come for the world-famous Big Top, stay because the Ringmaster has literally stolen your soul! Admission is free, but leaving will cost you an arm and a leg.

maps.name: Battlebridge
maps.description: This jagged span of wood and stone turns every crossing into a desperate fight for survival. More than just a path, it is a blood-stained choke point where narrow walkways and crumbling cover force players to think fast or be shoved into the abyss.

maps.name: Amphail Mountain Town
maps.description: Amphail wasn’t built for comfort; it was built to be a bottleneck. Wedged directly into a rocky valley, this fort-town is the only way to reach the sacred grounds further up the mountain. It’s the perfect spot for a high-stakes checkpoint, a mountain siege, or a tense meeting with the local wardens.

maps.name: Flubs Ferry
maps.description: Ferry man Aye, but not for the souls of the dead, at least, not always, ain't no river Styx, this just a big ol pond, and if ye wanna get across ye definitely be paying tolls to this Ferry man.

maps.name: Mystic Camp
maps.description: The Mystic Traveler’s Camp & Ritual Circle serves as a glowing sanctuary and a mysterious crossroads for those trekking through the deep woods. Its camp is a gathering of ornate wagons and weathered rugs surrounding a central ritual circle that hums with a faint, rhythmic magic.

maps.name: Thieves Guild (Free)
maps.description: Enter the Den of the Night Owl, Bootless Benny, The thieves guild is a tighly packed map & adventure

maps.name: Sewer Rats Refuge
maps.description: Down where the bricks weep, he holds his court. That ain't just a crown on his head it's a cursed artifact, and it gave the beast that wears it a wicked, human cunning. His kingdom is built on stolen goods and lost things. Now, his swarming subjects are getting bolder, and their chittering sounds like dark prayers. He doesn't just want our scraps anymore; he wants the whole town. Someone has to go down and break his crown.

maps.name: Weeping Woods
maps.description: In the Dark Wood stands a Tree older than time itself. Much like a spring produces water, The Weeping Ash produces a green nectar that has come deep from the earth, filtered through it's roots and disposed out of it's trunk. Some say the nectar is the cure to many remedies.

maps.name: Artificers Workshop
maps.description:
If you need gear no one else can make, you brave the northern cliffs to see Torvin. His workshop is a multi-level marvel bolted right into the mountain face, filled with the hum of enchanted gears and the glow of crystal cores. He's a surly hermit, but his artificed weapons are the finest in the land.

They say his other great art is his wine. So, if you want his help, my advice? Bring a good bottle as a greeting. It's the only language he speaks besides gears.

maps.name: Royal Study
maps.description: This is the King's private sanctuary. Here, with only his wolf for company, he searches his collection of forbidden texts for a cure to the Spreading Blight. He allows only his most trusted monastic scholars to study here, hoping their combined wisdom can find the secret that will save the world before it is too late.

maps.name: Fleshworks
maps.description: This is the Fleshworks, a grim parody of a factory where the production line deals in death. Here, the Master rejects stone and clay, using lightning and alchemy to stitch life into his golems. Chains hoist components to the assembly table, where the city's missing are grimly repurposed.
